'''Station Guardian One''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] developed by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] in [[3637 BBY]] it was destroyed aboard the [[Kuat Defensive Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Station Guardian One appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' as a possible boss during the "Kuat Drive Yards" flashpoint.<ref name="SWTOR" />
